investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Sableix Games (online gaming); Platform: on-premises data center DC-West, server range 10.134.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster sablei-prod (kubeadm); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic rewards-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer rewards-svc, consumer telemetry-ingest; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
